text.text_excerpt: This place made my trip! We were feeling fancy one night and king fish dis not disappoint. The cocktails were amazing. I had quite a few of some blueberry vodka thing which is my new favorite cocktail. The staff was super nice and attentive and even gave us extra bread. Speaking of, that pimento cheese spread is the jam. Seriously I could have had that as a meal. I had the special of the night which was scallops, shrimp, and bacon on top of grits. Everything was delicious but those grit may have seriously been the best thing I ever ate. This dinner is on my top 5 best meals. I highly suggest this place.

This place is great! The cocktails are awesome! The bar is cool too! For dinner I got the lil bites. I got the crawfish and artichoke au gratin served with salt and pepper bread with olive oil. The bread was a bit salty but they also gave plain bread. I used for the au gratin. The au gratin was delicious it had the right kick and spices with Parmesan cheese on top. Then next dish was the blackened bbq shrimp and crispy grit cake. It was tasty. There take on shrimp and grits. It came with 3 gulf shrimps and 1 grit cake cut in half. Then I got two drinks French 75 and Blueberry hill. They were excellent refreshing cocktails. Service was on point.

I came in for brunch with my boyfriend and we really enjoyed our food. The cocktail list was very good. We really enjoyed the ambience of the bar and restaurant. We decided to order the Boudin balls as well as the crab claws. The creole mustard with the Boudin balls was excellent and the crab claws weren't the best I've had in New Orleans but they were still very good. I prefer my crab claws heated versus cold. The highlight of the meal was the black drum fish tacos. They were seasoned really well and there was a lot of great toppings that you could use to make your tacos.
